concerns.text: FR-001 states the system MUST ingest the datasets and extract source code and logs for every patch, but it provides no measurable completeness threshold (e.g., ≥ 99 % of patches). Add a quantitative success condition so the requirement can be objectively verified.

FR-005 requires categorizing false positives/negatives into specific code‑behavior categories, yet the taxonomy is only exemplified (e.g., “dynamic dispatch”, “external I/O”) and no validation criteria (precision/recall) are given. Define the full set of categories and a measurable way to confirm correct tagging.
